pull.title: test: speed up wallet unit test
pull.body:
Deduplicates wallet creation code and avoid pre-deriving a large keypool (default 1000) by setting wallet keypool_size = 1

Speedup:

| Suite | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| coinselector_tests | 8.26 s | 3.35 s |
| wallet_tests | 2.10 s | 1.68 s |
| spend_tests | 0.59 s | 0.18 s |
| group_outputs_tests | 0.33 s | 0.12 s |
